title: Manager, Sales Compensation
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Manager, Sales Compensation **(Individual Contributor)**, you’ll play a critical role in scaling and operating the incentive programs that power Rippling’s go-to-market organization. Sitting within Accounting and partnering closely with the RevOps team, you’ll help ensure our sales teams are compensated accurately, on time, and in alignment with Rippling’s growth goals.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Systems, with ownership over commission processing, platform administration, and performance analytics. You’ll be responsible for executing and improving core compensation processes, maintaining data integrity across systems, and building reporting that provides visibility into sales performance and incentive outcomes.

This is a highly quantitative, detail-oriented role. You’ll be trusted as the subject matter expert for commission calculations and payout mechanics, while also contributing to process improvements and scalable systems as Rippling continues to grow. If you enjoy working with complex data, solving compensation challenges, and supporting fast-paced sales organizations, this role offers meaningful impact and growth.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Support the design, rollout, and ongoing administration of sales compensation programs, plan documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous process improvements
* Own end-to-end sales commission operations, including monthly and quarterly calculations, validations, reconciliations, accruals, reporting, audit support, and payout preparation, ensuring accuracy and compliance
* Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical models to track quota attainment, commission payouts, performance trends, and scenario modeling to support incentive strategy and plan updates
* Administer and scale Rippling’s Incentive Compensation Management platform, including compensation plan configuration, calculation logic, report

title: IT Operations Assistant
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented IT Operations Assistant with at least 1 year of relevant experience to support our IT Operations and Infrastructure team. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring IT operations, coordinating with technical teams, managing operational follow-ups, supporting infrastructure-related activities, and maintaining proper documentation.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of IT infrastructure, good coordination skills, and the ability to independently handle day-to-day operational responsibilities while ensuring timely task completion.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Monitoring and Escalation**

• Monitor daily alerts through Zabbix and identify critical, recurring, or unusual issues.

• Track technical team activities and follow up on assigned tasks to ensure timely completion.

• Coordinate with relevant team members to ensure operational issues are addressed and resolved within the expected timelines.

• Assist in quality monitoring across teams and identify operational gaps.

• Prepare monitoring updates and escalate unresolved or critical issues to the concerned team.

**2. IT and Infrastructure Coordination**

• Coordinate internal server management and infrastructure-related activities with the technical team.

• Handle laptop procurement, maintenance follow-ups, and IT asset record management.

• Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for IT-related requirements and service requests.

• Track IT-related requests and ensure proper follow-up until closure.

• Maintain updated records of IT assets, maintenance activities, and infrastructure requirements.

**3. Team Support and Coordination**

• Coordinate with technical team members regarding daily operational activities, task progress, and pending assignments.

• Ensure proper communication and follow-ups between different teams.

• Prepare, update, and maintain engineer profiles (ServerAdminz resumes) based on client and project requirements.

• Assist in resource coordination and ensure timely completion of assigned operational activities.

• Maintain regular updates on team activities and report delays or concerns to the concerned stakeholders.

**4. Documentation and Compliance**

• Assist in preparing, maintaining, and updating ISO-related documentation.

• Maintain accurate operational records and ensure documents are readily available for audit requirements.

• Coordinate with relevant teams to collect required information and supporting documents for compliance activities.

• Prepare and maintain operational reports, trackers, and documentation.

• Ensure proper documentation of IT operations, infrastructure activities, and internal processes.

**Required Skills**

• Minimum 1 year of experience in IT Operations, IT Coordination, Infrastructure Support, or a related role.

• Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, server operations, and monitoring tools.

• Familiarity with monitoring tools
